sections.title: Listening: Young People in the News

content.script: A young girl's film is teaching people across the world about the effects of climate change on farming communities in Nicaragua. Edelsin Linette Mendez lives with her family in the beautiful mountains of Nicaragua. For generations, the people in this community have worked as coffee farmers. But higher temperatures and a lack of water are making farming more difficult. The family can only produce half as much coffee as they used to. In 2017, when Edelsin was just twelve years old, she worked with a film-maker to make a documentary about these problems. She knew that if more people were aware of the effects of climate change on communities like hers, they could do more about it. Millions of young people around the world have seen the film at home or at school. After watching the film, some students have started their own groups to fight climate change. Edelsin's goal is to continue educating people around the world, so that we can work together to fight climate change and find solutions to the problems that it causes.
